resources.string: Send the plan to the agent
Just start talking. Live Mode listens, answers out loud, and saves the conversation to this chat.
Implement what we planned in the Live Mode conversation. Use the decisions from it, and ask me before guessing on anything it left open.
The chat couldn\'t take the plan right now. Try again from the chat.
Live Mode stopped. Tap to try again.
This device has no speech recognizer. Switch to Groq Whisper in Voice settings.
Speech recognition can\'t reach its service. Check your connection and tap to try again.
Groq Whisper needs an API key. Add one in Voice settings.
The Live Mode model\'s provider is gone. Pick another model in Live Mode settings.
Hands-free voice planning on a fast model
Talk through ideas without tapping send. Replies are read aloud and the whole conversation is saved to the chat, so the agent can act on it later.
This is an early version. Expect rough edges with noisy rooms, long pauses and some speech engines. Start it from the button on an empty message box, or from the + menu while a task runs.
A fast, light model keeps spoken replies quick. The main agent keeps its own model, so a running task is not affected.
Live Mode never edits files or runs commands itself. To act, it hands the plan to the main agent, which works with this chat\'s usual permissions and approvals.
No tools. Fastest replies, from the conversation alone.
Can read files and search to answer, never changes anything.
When you say go ahead, it sends the plan to the main agent to build. You can also send it with the button in Live Mode.
Read each reply aloud with your Voice settings. The microphone waits until it finishes.
How long you can stop talking before Live Mode answers. Raise it if it cuts you off mid-thought.
